_about: What the site keeps in a visitor's browser, in one place: the Privacy Policy lists the choices from here, and scripts/check-privacy.mjs holds the site to it. A choice that is added, or code that starts to use browser storage, is added here in the same commit as the page's wording.

choices.what: whether you chose light or dark mode, shared between the home page and the documentation
the package manager you chose in the install commands (pnpm, npm or yarn)
